Momentum increase their attack speed based on this. }} {{status | name = Swiftness | icon = Swiftness status icon.png | type = Buff |description = You have increased movement speed. }} '''Momentum Support''' is a [[support gem]]. When you use the supported [[attack]] skill, it grants a stack of {{stl|Momentum}}, granting increased [[attack speed]] per stack. Momentum is removed when you move while you have it. At five stacks, Momentum is removed to grant the {{stl|Swiftness}} buff, which grants increased [[movement speed]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''Duration''': Modifiers to skill effect duration also apply to the duration of Swiftness granted by the skill * '''Minions''': [[Minion]]s fully benefit from Momentum support, visibly gaining swiftness upon reaching maximum momentum stacks. * '''Totems''': [[Totem]]s also benefit from Momentum support, visibly gaining swiftness upon reaching maximum momentum stacks. * '''Momentum stack calculation''': Momentum is gained right when you start the attack, which means your first attack will have the attack speed with 1 Momentum. ** For non-channelling skills, the attacks which puts you at maximum momentum stacks will have its attack speed at max momentum, despite the fact all the stacks were removed to gain Swiftness. ** For channelling skills, attack speed is calculated dynamically, so when you reach maximum momentum stacks, it will have its attack speed at 0 momentum. This causes channelling skills to have its attack speed at most one under the maximum momentum stacks.[https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3324396#THU1 Crucible RAQ] ** {{il|Shield Charge}}: This support works favourably with Shield Charge, as the Momentum buff is not lost at the end of movement. Using Shield Charge with the cursor close to the character will cause Shield Charge to attack in place, which permits Momentum to stack and grant Swiftness.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j1ZYRGj4m-w Level 9 Momentum would be best for this scenario as it only requires 3 stacks of Momentum to trigger Swiftness. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Channeling
Momentum
gain |c1_header = Gain 1 Momentum every x seconds while Channelling a Supported Skill |c1_pattern_extract = Gain 1 Momentum every (%d+)%.(%d+) seconds while Channelling a Supported Skill |c1_pattern_value = %d.%ds |c2_abbr = Attack speed |c2_header = Supported Skills have x% increased Attack Speed per Momentum |c2_pattern_extract = Supported Skills have (%d+)%% increased Attack Speed per Momentum |c2_pattern_value = %d |c3_abbr = Maximum
Momentum |c3_header = When you reach x Momentum, lose all Momentum and gain Swiftness for 1.5 seconds |c3_pattern_extract = When you reach (%d+) Momentum, lose all Momentum |c3_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} In addition, if the player choose to play [[Ranger]], the [[Large Chest The Twilight Strand (Act 1)|Large Chest]] in the first area of the game: [[The Twilight Strand (Act 1)|The Twilight Strand]] will guaranteed to drop this gem. ==Related modifiers== The following [[modifier]]s are related to Onslaught Support: {{modifier table |q_tables=spawn_weights |q_join=mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = granted_skill = "SupportMomentum" AND NOT mods.generation_type = 3 AND spawn_weights.weight > 0 |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |tags=1 }} ===Legacy mods=== {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = granted_skill = "SupportMomentum" |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |spawn_weights=1 |generation_type=1 |tags=1 }} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Momentum Support: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables = item_stats |join = item_stats._pageName=items._pageName |where = item_stats.id LIKE "%level_x_onslaught%" OR items.stat_text LIKE "%random Support Gem%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} In additions, {{il|Replica Forbidden Shako}} also grants this support gem, but the unique item itself is drop disabled and its mod are identical to non-legacy Forbidden Shako. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.21.0| * Onslaught Support has been removed.
